column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 to gist (Semantic Arts) Upper Ontology Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) LinkML schema and the gist minimal upper ontology (Semantic Arts). Mappings anchor ISO/IEC 22989 entities to gist upper-ontology classes for Organization, Person, Event, Task and related foundational concepts to support integration with gist-based knowledge graphs.

column10: Individual human users of AI systems are persons in gist.
Data subjects are individuals (persons) whose data is processed by AI.
AI lifecycle processes are happenings situated in time and are subtypes of gist event.
Both denote tasks performed (by AI agents or otherwise).
Data processes are events transforming or moving data.
An ISO/IEC 22989 action is an executed event in the gist sense.
A decision is a determination among alternatives.
A knowledge graph is composed of knowledge concepts and their relations.
